_source: VASSAL module CombatCommanderEurope-2.6.4.vmod buildFile.xml, Parts palette (PieceSlots) with prototypes expanded; front values = dynamic-property start values, broken values = start value + the Ctrl-B (break) increment of each property; boxed values = "Box *" prototype; weapon portage/move penalty = "Wpn MP n" layer; repair/eliminate rolls = broken-side image name; radio artillery FP and SMOKE read from the radio counter images.
_verification: Front values of every squad/team/weapon in the 2006 and 2025 GMT Order-of-Battle and Support charts shipped in the module (images/CC * Order of Battle.jpg, * OOB Table.png, CC * Support Table.jpg, RSG Leaders and Fortifications.png) were compared and agree, including boxes and weapon penalties. Broken-side values are module-only (no broken-side art in the module) - verify against physical counters before relying on them.
_counter_mix: The module does NOT contain the counter mix (VASSAL palettes are unlimited). Leaders are unique named counters (1 each). For everything else "count" is null; "max_needed_in_base_scenarios" is the largest number used by any one of the 12 scenarios (lower bound only).
